valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date, Nov 2027). FY2026 EPS is derived, not reported: FY2026 guidance of $51.1B revenue at a 31.5% operating margin gives about $16.1B operating income; Q3 2026 net income per operating dollar (about 0.82, from $0.87 EPS x 4.195B diluted shares over 34.6% margin on $12.87B revenue) converts it to about $13.2B net income, or about $3.14 per diluted share on 4.195B shares. Scenario EPS is built from revenue growth, operating margin, the same 0.82 conversion and diluted shares. Price is for the NFLX US listing in USD; no ADR or FX conversion needed.

bear.driver: Ad revenue shortfall continues (FY2026 ad outlook already cut to about $2.7B from about $3B); the Q4 2026 headcount-reduction margin drag persists into 2027, holding operating margin near 28%; growth slows to about 7%
bear.assumption: FY2027 revenue about $54.7B at a 28% operating margin, 0.82 conversion, about 4.15B shares: EPS $3.03 x 16x

base.driver: Revenue growth moderates from 13% to about 11%; operating margin recovers to about 32% after the Q4 2026 headcount drag; buybacks offset dilution
base.assumption: FY2027 revenue about $56.7B at a 32% operating margin, 0.82 conversion, about 4.15B shares: EPS $3.58 x 20x

bull.driver: Pricing and ad tier lift growth to about 15%; margin reaches 34%; multiple re-rates toward growth-stock levels
bull.assumption: FY2027 revenue about $58.8B at a 34% operating margin, 0.82 conversion, about 4.10B shares: EPS $4.00 x 24x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $3.58, the $62.15 close implies 17.4x; the close is 19.8x derived FY2026 EPS of $3.14. The provider mean target of $84.76 (43 analysts, Yahoo Finance via yfinance, pipeline aggregate) implies 23.7x base EPS, or about $4.24 EPS at 20x. The unweighted mean of the seven named targets in the events ($84.43, +35.8% vs close) implies 23.6x base EPS, or about $4.22 EPS at 20x. None of the named targets enter the base case.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.58 (5.8 pp of the close). A $0.10 change in FY2027 base EPS moves the base target by $2.00 (3.2 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: FY2027 operating margin trajectory (base 32%) and advertising revenue versus the cut FY2026 outlook of about $2.7B; a margin that stays near Q4 2026 guidance of 26% would break the base case.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 and FY2026 results with FY2027 commentary (next earnings release; date not confirmed in the sources reviewed, expected January 2027).

analyst_notes: Nine named analysts with dated calls since Sept 2026: six Buy-rated (UBS $110 from $115, Guggenheim $78 from $80, Seaport $85 from $90, Jefferies $85, TD Cowen $100, William Blair Outperform with no target), one Hold with no target (Needham), one Hold (HSBC, $76 from $96, Sept 22) and one Underweight/Sell (Wells Fargo, $57 from $80, about Sept 18). Five of the seven targets are Oct 21 post-earnings actions. Targets are only partly dated: Jefferies' and TD Cowen's prior targets are not stated, so they carry unknown prior. No named target has a documented 12-month horizon, so none enter a weighted target. The unweighted named-target mean of $84.43 is +35.8% from the close, 20.6 pp above the base case (+15.2%). Reaching that mean at base EPS needs about 23.6x, so analysts are assuming either margin recovery above our 32% or a higher multiple than the 20x base. The sample skews bullish in target terms, with the Sept HSBC and Wells Fargo cuts the only Hold or Sell calls; the provider's 43-analyst mean of $84.76 is a published aggregate, not individual calls. Two unresolved points: the Needham analyst name (Laura Martin) comes from a Stocktwits search excerpt and a German outlet, and a Benzinga roundup says a $120 Needham target was withdrawn while Stocktwits and Goldesel say no target was issued, so no Needham target row is recorded. The Wells Fargo date (Sept 18) comes from search summaries; TheWrap confirms only that the action came less than a week before HSBC's Sept 22 note.
